end.summary: Practised reading and plotting points from ordered pairs, quadrant identification, axes, and reflections.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised using coordinate signs to identify quadrants and correctly handled points on the axes and reflections. They mixed up the order in ordered pairs, treating (3,2) and (2,3) as the same; this was still not corrected in the final turn. At home, ask them to plot several ordered pairs and say “x first, then y” before marking each point.
